title.value: An Empirical Study of Retrieval-enhanced Graph Neural Networks
title.justification: The title is directly taken from the top of the paper and matches the provided information.
title.quote: An Empirical Study of Retrieval-enhanced Graph Neural Networks

extractions.description: This paper explores the application of retrieval-enhanced mechanisms in Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) to improve graph property prediction tasks, such as graph classification and regression. The authors propose a framework named GRAPH RETRIEVAL, which augments GNNs by retrieving similar graphs from an existing database, thereby enhancing predictive performance, especially in cases with long-tailed label distributions. The study demonstrates substantial improvements across 13 datasets, suggesting that retrieval enhancement holds promise for further improving GNN models in terms of performance and handling imbalanced data.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper primarily focuses on enhancing the performance of GNNs through a retrieval-enhanced framework, aiming at improving generic machine learning tasks such as graph classification and regression. There is no direct emphasis on climate or ecologically-related sustainable development applications.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: In this study, we focus on two common tasks in the realm of graph neural networks: graph classification and graph regression.
